Keep the established heading/camera through the transition; back-view headings show the man's back rather than switching to the old front side pose. Non-graphic fictional game death: no blood, wounds, gore, body damage or severed limbs. Preserve mature stern face, black tied long hair/headband, indigo-charcoal traveller robe, large brown prayer beads, forearm guards, pale shin wraps, dark boots and ragged cloth panels, exactly TWO single curved sabres total. Standing/recoil has healthy spine; the following natural fatal collapse is NOT a normal idle hunch. Body/head/hand/boot anatomy and scale must match Image 1; no chibi, oversized head, shortened adult limbs or squashed torso. Painterly detailed RTS style and warm shading from Image 1. All head/hair, blades, boots and full lying body fit inside their own cell with generous transparent margins; lying body may be wider but must not be shrunk into a tiny corpse. No overlap, clipping, text, labels, panels, ground, shadows, effects or background. Genuine transparent RGBA.
